ITT is a diversified leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions for the transportation, industrial, nutrition and health and energy markets. The company operates through three value centers: Flow Technologies, Motion Technologies and Connect & Control Technologies. Building on its heritage of innovation, ITT partners with its customers to deliver enduring solutions to the key industries that underpin our modern way of life.
